baseline.cleanup: The pre-fix test restores only an independently captured replacement context; actual console I/O and normal reaping of both processes are mandatory.

changes: Verify actual mm alias identity through one owned private scratch byte before restoring context and after collecting new recovery stops
Retire same-file replacement recovery even when PID, birth, inode and old mm readability are unchanged
Retain a failed probe restoration original byte across retries and restore it through its pinned old descriptor after exec
Support private syscall scratch ending at a page boundary without expanding the scratch contract
Reject borrowed/quiesced mixed-restart sites before mutation until a private identity-proof owner exists
Never replay a successful SYSEMU; retry an ambiguous failed request only at the exact prepared GP bank and prepared stop fingerprint
Deterministically establish real pre-entry SIGSTOP with a test-owned interrupt and unchanged actual GP bank; consume only the owned interrupt and leave the real queued notification for production
Require separate bounded shared-mm suite and automatically build its fixture

proofScope.oldMmCleanupModel: The actual fixture peer exits and both processes are reaped; independent old-mm allocation cleanup with a surviving peer is not proved.
proofScope.model: Caller-owned private scratch, actual interrupted INT80 timer in ELF64, deliberately redirected same-file exec and consumed actual EXEC event, separate CLONE_VM peer retaining the original mm. All replacement GP/extended state/mask and actual console work are preserved.
proofScope.counting: Assertions include repeated setup and verification. Suite/build totals are separate and do not count unique supported features.

remaining: Writable pinned old mm and caller-owned private scratch are required by this draft; read-only transport and borrowed/quiesced private proof ownership remain
Completed recovery records reused as expected-image guards require independent live task/image-affinity proof
Independent old-mm allocation cleanup while a separate CLONE_VM peer remains alive needs an ownership path
SIGSTOP in other recovery phases and repeated/concurrent job-control transitions
Unexpected foreign synchronous signal decisions and syscall-user-dispatch policy
Cancellation, broker/frontend shutdown, nonleader exec and asynchronous lifecycle race windows in every phase
Other restart classes, x32 and additional kernels
